literal: Having examined the doer, having examined the work, and having understood how they fit with the right time, perform it.
translation: Examine the agent, examine the enterprise, and having understood how they fit with the proper time, execute the task.
modern: செயலைச் செய்பவனை ஆராய்ந்து, செய்ய வேண்டிய செயலையும் ஆராய்ந்து, அச்செயலைச் செய்வதற்குப் பொருத்தமான காலத்தையும் அறிந்து அச்செயலைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential factors a leader must analyze before executing any task: the person, the work, and the timing. First, one must evaluate the capability and character of the person chosen for the job. Second, the nature, challenges, and requirements of the work itself must be assessed. Finally, the leader must understand how the task and the doer align with the right timing before initiating the action.
